name: Witch Hunter ~2 Gou mo Choroi ze~
original_name: ウィッチハンター ～2号もちょろいぜ～
source:
Aqua rescues Rose from the clutches of the protagonist, but Rose immediately disappears, leaving Aqua with just a few short words.

For several weeks after the magical girl Rose's disappearance, Aqua was shown on television searching for her and fighting the evil organization. The protagonist and Azrael Dues watched such Aqua with wicked smiles. And with them was a third person... Angelic Rose.

"To corrupt Aqua."

"To get Rose back."

The battle between the protagonist and magical girl Angelic Aqua has begun.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/witchhunter/index.html#story]official site[/url]]
